persona: mastra-hybrid — staged intake/triage/plan/review gates mixed with free sandbox build (Mastra Factory)

hybrid.staged_half: explicit stage gates: intake → triage → planning → review → completion (DET transitions + HITL)
hybrid.free_half: Building stage = free sandbox agent session (persistent coding agent, tools in sandbox) — not a micro-DET script leaf
hybrid.why_not_compose_pure: Unlike ElasticClaw/Fabro (0-token hub owns every next hop), Mastra Factory mixes measurable stage gates with a freer build session inside the sandbox
hybrid.why_not_agent_loop: Agent does not pick next factory stage or merge; humans/gates advance triage/plan/review

mastra_factory.orchestrator: Mastra Factory Server + typed rules / stage machine (UI board)
mastra_factory.llm_placement: triage assist + plan draft + free build session + optional separate review session — never sole merge authority
mastra_factory.optional_goal_mode: /goal via subagents — out of default klepacz map; default = staged gates
mastra_factory.platform_note: template may push Mastra platform; --no-platform / local sandbox OK for klepacz host
